name: Wild Romania
description: The Carpathian Mountains, the Danube River and the Black Sea, gave birth to the wildest country in Europe. The richness of this place lies in spectacular mountains, in rivers full of life, in healthy forests. Following the four seasons of the year, we will discover the life of the most emblematic animals of Romania and we will unfold the story of the most amazing natural landscapes.

videos.title: Season of Hope
videos.overview: The journey begins with the long-awaited arrival of spring, a season of hope when most animals prepare for a new cycle of life.

videos.title: Season of Plenty
videos.overview: Our journey will continue with the arrival of summer, a season of plenty when the young animals are starting to enjoy the beauty of life and accept the challenges of nature.

videos.title: Season of Change
videos.overview: Our journey will come to an end with the arrival of autumn which will turn into winter once more in the season of change.
